inputs.text: {"high_level_description": "Skullpeak, a frozen mountain range of humans with polished steel bones grown through their bodies, sharpshooters who wait behind walls, and every rock here aims at you. Rendered entirely in crisp, deliberately clustered pixel art. Modern high quality pixel art like Sea of Stars: bright, colourful and readable, never muddy. A war torn brutal planet where everything wants to kill everything, told with absurd deadpan humour. A section of one wide connected region panorama, refined with crisp pixel clusters.", "style_description": {"medium": "pixel_art", "art_style": "Authentic hand pixelled 2D game battle stage background. Visible square pixel clusters and stair stepped contours everywhere. Flat colour clusters, two to four shades per material. Crisp pixel edges without antialiasing. Clean readable shapes. No paint brushwork, no gradients except a dithered sky, no noise texture.", "aesthetics": "bright readable war torn battle stage with absurd deadpan humour, coherent pixel clusters, a real place with depth", "lighting": "Clear cold morning light from the upper left, soft blue shadows on the snow, as discrete flat pixel colour planes, the snowy floor in calm even light.", "color_palette": ["#6aa8e0", "#c4e2f6", "#f4f8fc", "#d8e4ee", "#9aaabc", "#4a5468", "#2e3444", "#b8c2cc", "#e8eef2", "#2ad0c0", "#8ef2e6", "#7a2a3a", "#a83a4a", "#8a96a6", "#6e7a8a"]}, "compositional_deconstruction": {"background": "A section of a continuous 2.5D battle stage panorama seen from a fixed side oblique camera, no people: sky above a distant horizon, scenery behind the arena in overlapping rows, a calm empty floor.", "elements": [{"type": "obj", "bbox": [0, 0, 300, 1000], "desc": "a crisp pale blue cold sky with thin high clouds"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [540, 0, 1000, 1000], "desc": "one calm, empty floor of packed white snow over grey flagstones running the whole width, a worn trail of trodden snow along its back edge through all three places"}]}}
